limits: This is AI source review, not an eo-lifecycle-review/v1 independent_human record.
Prospective-authority cessation can be supported while the exact submitted complete first-end claim is rejected.
Original page-image confirmation is not asserted; three EO13350 legal-body rendered pages were independently inspected.
rationale: The unable decision is justified for the frozen interface. All eleven visible original scopes and the full alternate text were read. Additional agency information and Council-specific FACA delegation in the alternate cannot be manufactured as spans inside the truncated selected original. EO12756 section 1 continues the Council to November 13, 1993 and section 2 changes membership 30 to 35; neither the unamended November 13, 1991 candidate nor membership amendment is a whole ending. EO12869 sections 4(d)/6 expressly revoke it September 30, 1993, before the extension end. These sources permit chronology research but do not fix the frozen complete-original defect or satisfy the alternate page check.

required_corrections_or_open_tasks.reason: Selected recheck text stops after section 3(c). The already-held alternate full original includes sections 3(d), 4(a) and 4(b), so this is a source-selection/page-reconciliation blocker, not exhaustion or absence of all original evidence.
required_corrections_or_open_tasks.required_correction: Inspect official pages 54 FR 47507-47508 for the alternate requires_page_check flag, correct the selected original in a separately frozen dossier, and derive a complete inventory before approval. No canonical edit authorized here.

search_scope_limits.limitations: Machine corpus search metadata is a bounded contrary-evidence check, not proof of a current legal predicate. U.S. Code coverage ends 2026-10-09; eCFR uses cutoff point-in-time. Machine hits are not classified as operative current predicates solely by number. The supplied dossier has no attributed current-law leads except EO12722. No additional corpus extraction/acquisition was undertaken.
